questions.knowledgePoint: as if与现在相反：用过去式
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他说话的样子好像他什么都懂。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He looked as if he ___ a ghost.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他看起来好像见了鬼似的。
questions.explanation: as if/though引导的从句，如果与过去事实相反，用过去完成时had done。'He looked as if he had seen a ghost'表示他看起来好像见了鬼（在looked之前发生，与过去相反）。主句looked是过去时，as if从句表示更早的过去，用had seen。
questions.knowledgePoint: as if与过去相反：用had done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他看起来好像见了鬼似的。

questions.question: True or False: 'It looks as if it is going to rain.' must use the subjunctive mood.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'It looks as if it is going to rain.' 必须使用虚拟语气。
questions.explanation: 错误。as if/though后面的从句不一定都用虚拟语气。当从句的情况可能发生/可能真实时，用陈述语气。'It looks as if it is going to rain'中看起来真的要下雨了（可能真实），用陈述语气is going to。只有当从句与事实明显相反时才用虚拟语气。区分：可能真实用陈述；明显虚假用虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: as if：可能真实用陈述语气
questions.sentenceTranslation: 看起来好像要下雨了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It is high time we ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们该走了。
questions.explanation: It is (high/about) time that...后从句用虚拟语气：过去式或should+动词原形（should不可省略）。'It is high time we went'表示'我们该走了'（该做而未做）。went是go的过去式表虚拟。选项A(go)原形不对；选项C(will go)将来时不对；选项D(going)分词不对。也可用should go但不能省略should。
questions.knowledgePoint: It is time that...：从句用过去式
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们该走了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It's time you ___ to bed.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：你该上床睡觉了。
questions.explanation: It's time that...后用过去式虚拟语气。'It's time you went to bed'表示你该睡觉了（该做而未做）。went是go的过去式。It is time结构有两种形式：①It is time for sb to do sth（不定式，非虚拟）；②It is time that sb did sth（虚拟语气，过去式）。
questions.knowledgePoint: It's time that sb did sth
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你该上床睡觉了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is time we ___ (leave) now.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们现在该离开了。
questions.explanation: It is time that...后从句用过去式虚拟语气。leave的过去式是left。'It is time we left'表示我们该离开了（该做而未做）。It is time结构总结：It is time for sb to do（不定式）；It is (high/about) time that sb did/should do（虚拟语气，过去式或should+原形，should不可省）。
questions.knowledgePoint: It is time that...：用过去式虚拟
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们现在该离开了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: On the table ___ some books.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：桌子上有一些书。
questions.explanation: 完全倒装：表示地点的介词短语放句首时，谓语动词提到主语前面。'On the table are some books'中are提前到主语some books前。完全倒装结构：地点副词/介词短语+谓语+主语。注意主谓一致：some books是复数，用are。选项A和D加了there不符合完全倒装结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: 完全倒装：地点介词短语+谓语+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 桌子上有一些书。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Here ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：公交车来了。
questions.explanation: here/there放句首且主语是名词时，用完全倒装：Here/There+谓语+主语。'Here comes the bus'中comes提前到the bus前。完全倒装的条件：①here/there/away/up/down等副词放句首；②主语是名词（不是代词）。如果主语是代词则不倒装：Here it comes（不倒装）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 完全倒装：Here+谓语+名词主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 公交车来了。

questions.question: True or False: 'Here he comes.' is the correct inverted form.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'Here he comes.' 是正确的倒装形式。
questions.explanation: 正确。当here/there放句首且主语是代词时，不倒装，用'Here+主语+谓语'。'Here he comes'中he是代词，不倒装。对比：如果主语是名词则倒装'Here comes the bus'。完全倒装规则：here/there+谓语+名词主语（倒装）；here/there+代词主语+谓语（不倒装）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 完全倒装例外：代词主语不倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他来了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Never ___ such a beautiful place.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我从未见过如此美丽的地方。
questions.explanation: 否定词never放句首时，用部分倒装（助动词/情态动词/be动词提到主语前）。'Never have I seen such a beautiful place'中have提到I前。部分倒装：否定词+助动词+主语+谓语。常见的否定词：never, hardly, seldom, little, not only, no sooner等。选项A未倒装；选项C和D时态不对。
questions.knowledgePoint: 部分倒装：否定词句首+助动词+主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我从未见过如此美丽的地方。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Not only ___ English, but also he speaks French.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。
questions.explanation: not only放句首时，其所在分句用部分倒装。'Not only does he speak English'中does提到he前。部分倒装结构：Not only+助动词+主语+谓语。not only...but also...结构中，not only句倒装，but also句不倒装。选项A未倒装；选项B语序不对。
questions.knowledgePoint: 部分倒装：Not only句首倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Hardly ___ I arrived when it started to rain. (用正确倒装形式)
questions.questionCn: 填空：我刚到家就开始下雨了。
questions.explanation: Hardly...when...结构中，Hardly放句首时用部分倒装。'Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain'中had提到I前。Hardly...when...=一……就……，主句用过去完成时(had done)，when从句用一般过去时。部分倒装：Hardly+had+主语+过去分词+when...
questions.knowledgePoint: 部分倒装：Hardly...when...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我刚到家就开始下雨了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It was in 1990 ___ he was born.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他是在1990年出生的。
questions.explanation: 强调句结构：It is/was+被强调部分+that/who+其他。此句强调时间状语in 1990，用that。强调句的判断方法：去掉It is/was和that后，句子仍完整通顺。'He was born in 1990.'去掉后仍然完整，所以是强调句。强调人时可用who，强调物/时间/地点用that。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句：It is/was+被强调部分+that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是在1990年出生的。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It was Tom ___ broke the window.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：是汤姆打破了窗户。
questions.explanation: 强调句中强调人时，that和who都可以用。'It was Tom that/who broke the window'两种都正确。强调人用that或who，强调物/时间/地点/原因等用that。选项D(which)不用于强调句。强调句的that不是关系代词，而是强调句的固定结构词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句强调人：that或who均可
questions.sentenceTranslation: 是汤姆打破了窗户。

questions.question: True or False: 'It was yesterday that I met him.' emphasizes the time 'yesterday'.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'It was yesterday that I met him.' 强调的是时间'yesterday'。
questions.explanation: 正确。此句是强调句，强调时间状语yesterday。原句为'I met him yesterday'，用It was...that...结构强调yesterday。验证方法：去掉'It was'和'that'，得到'I met him yesterday'，句子完整通顺，确认为强调句。强调句可以强调主语、宾语、时间状语、地点状语等，但不能强调谓语动词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 强调句：可强调时间状语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我是昨天遇见他的。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Some like coffee, ___ like tea.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：一些人喜欢咖啡，另一些人喜欢茶。
questions.explanation: others=other+复数名词，表示'另一些人/物'，是不定代词。'Some like coffee, others like tea'中others代替other people，后面的like tea省略了与前句相同的动词like（但others本身已包含主语功能）。选项B(the others)指特定范围内剩余全部；选项C(another)接单数；选项D(other)是形容词需接名词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 省略句：others替代省略
questions.sentenceTranslation: 一些人喜欢咖啡，另一些人喜欢茶。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: — Are you a student? — ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：——你是学生吗？——是的，我是。
choices: A. Yes, I am a student
questions.explanation: 简略回答中可省略与问句重复的部分。'Yes, I am'省略了'a student'。在对话中，为避免重复，常省略与问句相同的信息。选项A(Yes, I am a student)虽语法正确但不简洁；选项B是最自然的简略回答。省略是英语口语中的常见现象，使语言更简洁。
questions.knowledgePoint: 省略句：对话中简略回答
questions.sentenceTranslation: ——你是学生吗？——是的，我是。

questions.question: True or False: 'When young, he lived in Paris.' is a correct elliptical sentence.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'When young, he lived in Paris.' 是正确的省略句。
questions.explanation: 正确。'When young'是'When he was young'的省略形式。在when/while引导的时间状语从句中，如果从句主语与主句主语一致且含有be动词，可以省略主语和be动词。'When (he was) young, he lived in Paris'省略了he was。这种省略使句子更简洁。类似：While (he was) reading, he fell asleep.
questions.knowledgePoint: 省略句：状语从句中的省略
questions.sentenceTranslation: 年轻时他住在巴黎。

questions.question: Choose the correct tag question: He is a teacher, ___?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的反义疑问句：他是老师，对吧？
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句规则：前肯后否，前否后肯。前句'He is a teacher'是肯定句，疑问部分用否定isn't he。be动词的反义疑问用be动词：is→isn't...? 选项A(is he)前肯后肯，不对；选项C和D用了does，但原句是be动词不是实义动词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 反义疑问句：前肯后否，be动词用be
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是老师，不是吗？

questions.question: Choose the correct tag question: She doesn't like coffee, ___?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的反义疑问句：她不喜欢咖啡，对吧？
questions.explanation: 反义疑问句规则：前否后肯。前句'She doesn't like coffee'是否定句，疑问部分用肯定does she。实义动词的反义疑问用do/does/did。doesn't→does。选项B(doesn't she)前否后否不对；选项C和D用了is，但原句是实义动词不是be动词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 反义疑问句：前否后肯，实义动词用do/does
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她不喜欢咖啡，是吗？

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Let's go for a walk, ___?
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们去散步吧，好吗？
questions.explanation: Let's引导的祈使句，反义疑问部分用shall we。'Let's go for a walk, shall we?'注意区分：Let's（含说话者）用shall we；Let us（不含说话者）用will you。其他祈使句的反义疑问：肯定祈使句用will you/won't you；否定祈使句用will you。
questions.knowledgePoint: 反义疑问句：Let's...用shall we
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们去散步吧，好吗？

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ beautiful the flower is!
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：这朵花多美啊！
questions.explanation: How引导感叹句修饰形容词/副词：How+adj/adv+主语+谓语！'How beautiful the flower is'中beautiful是形容词，用How。What引导感叹句修饰名词：What+(a/an)+adj+名词+主语+谓语！选项A(What)和D(How a)不修饰形容词。区分：How修饰形容词/副词；What修饰名词。
questions.knowledgePoint: How感叹句：How+adj+主语+谓语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这朵花多美啊！

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ a good idea!
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：多好的主意啊！
questions.explanation: What引导感叹句修饰名词：What+(a/an)+adj+名词(!) 'What a good idea'中idea是可数名词单数，用What a。如果名词是复数或不可数则不加a/an：What good ideas! / What good weather! 选项A(What)缺少a；选项B(How)修饰形容词/副词不修饰名词。
questions.knowledgePoint: What感叹句：What+a/an+adj+可数名词单数
questions.sentenceTranslation: 多好的主意啊！

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ wonderful weather we have today!
questions.questionCn: 填空：今天的天气多好啊！
questions.explanation: weather是不可数名词，感叹句用What修饰且不加a/an。'What wonderful weather we have today!'感叹句结构：What+(不加a/an)+adj+不可数名词+主语+谓语! 不可数名词如weather, water, news, advice等用What修饰时不加a/an。How修饰形容词/副词；What修饰名词。
questions.knowledgePoint: What感叹句：不可数名词不加a/an
questions.sentenceTranslation: 今天的天气多好啊！

questions.question: Choose the correct form: — I like tea. — ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：——我喜欢茶。——我也是。
questions.explanation: So+助动词/情态动词/be动词+主语，表示'……也一样'（肯定情况）。'I like tea'是肯定句且用实义动词like，用So do I。选项B(So I do)语序不倒装，表示'确实如此'（赞同对方说法）；选项C(Neither do I)用于否定情况；选项D(So am I)用了be动词但原句是实义动词。
questions.knowledgePoint: So do I：肯定情况也相同
questions.sentenceTranslation: ——我喜欢茶。——我也是。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: — I don't like coffee. — ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：——我不喜欢咖啡。——我也不喜欢。
questions.explanation: Neither/Nor+助动词/情态动词/be动词+主语，表示'……也不'（否定情况）。'I don't like coffee'是否定句，用Neither do I。选项A(So do I)用于肯定情况；选项C(Neither I do)语序不对，应倒装；选项D(So don't I)结构不存在。注意：So用于肯定，Neither/Nor用于否定。
questions.knowledgePoint: Neither do I：否定情况也相同
questions.sentenceTranslation: ——我不喜欢咖啡。——我也不喜欢。

questions.question: True or False: '— He can swim. — So can I.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'——他会游泳。——我也会。' 语法正确。
questions.explanation: 正确。'He can swim'是肯定句且用情态动词can，回答用'So can I'（So+情态动词can+主语I）。So/neither倒装句中助动词/情态动词/be动词的选择取决于前句：前句用什么，后句就用什么。如前句用is→So is.../Neither is...；前句用has→So has.../Neither has...；前句用can→So can.../Neither can...
questions.knowledgePoint: So can I：情态动词的倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: ——他会游泳。——我也会。

questions.question: Which of the following is an uncountable noun?
questions.questionCn: 以下哪个是不可数名词？
questions.explanation: water是不可数名词，不能直接加a/an或表示复数加s。不可数名词没有复数形式，表示数量时需用量词：a glass of water, a bottle of water。选项A(book)、C(student)、D(apple)都是可数名词，可以加a/an和表示复数加s。常见不可数名词：water, milk, bread, money, information, advice, news等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不可数名词：不能加a/an或s
questions.sentenceTranslation: 水是不可数名词。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I need ___ information about this topic.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我需要一些关于这个话题的信息。
questions.explanation: information是不可数名词，不能用a/an修饰，用some修饰。some可修饰可数和不可数名词。选项A(a)和B(an)用于可数名词单数；选项D(many)只用于可数名词复数。不可数名词的量词搭配：much information, a lot of information, some information, a piece of information。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不可数名词用some/much修饰
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我需要一些关于这个话题的信息。

questions.question: True or False: 'I bought three breads at the store.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'I bought three breads at the store.' 语法正确。
questions.explanation: 此句错误。bread是不可数名词，不能加s表示复数。正确形式：'I bought three loaves of bread at the store.' 不可数名词表示数量时需用量词：a loaf of bread（一条面包）, a piece of bread（一片面包）。类似不可数名词：water→a glass of water, paper→a sheet of paper, money→some money。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不可数名词不能加s，需用量词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我在商店买了三条面包。

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'box'?
questions.questionCn: 'box'的复数形式是什么？
questions.explanation: 以s, x, ch, sh结尾的名词，复数加es。box以x结尾，复数加es→boxes。规则：一般加s（book→books）；s/x/ch/sh结尾加es（bus→buses, watch→watches）；辅音+y变y为i加es（city→cities）；元音+y直接加s（boy→boys）；f/fe变v加es（leaf→leaves）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词复数：s/x/ch/sh结尾加es
questions.sentenceTranslation: boxes是box的复数形式。

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'child'?
questions.questionCn: 'child'的复数形式是什么？
questions.explanation: child是不规则变化名词，复数为children。常见不规则复数：man→men, woman→women, child→children, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice, goose→geese, person→people。选项A(childs)按规则变化错误；选项C(childes)错误。不规则名词复数需要单独记忆。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词复数：不规则变化child→children
questions.sentenceTranslation: children是child的复数形式。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: There are three ___ (library) in our city.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们城市有三个图书馆。
questions.explanation: library以辅音字母+y结尾，复数变化规则：变y为i加es→libraries。注意：元音字母+y结尾直接加s（boy→boys, key→keys）。名词复数变化规则总结：一般加s；s/x/ch/sh/o结尾加es；辅音+y变y为i加es；f/fe变v加es；不规则变化需记忆。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词复数：辅音+y变y为i加es
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们城市有三个图书馆。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: This is ___ book.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：这是汤姆的书。
questions.explanation: 单数名词所有格在词尾加's。Tom是单数，所有格为Tom's。规则：单数名词+'s（Tom→Tom's）；以s结尾的复数名词加'（students→students'）；不以s结尾的复数名词加's（children→children's）。选项B(Toms)无所有格符号；选项C(Toms')是复数所有格形式，但Tom是单数。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词所有格：单数名词+'s
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这是汤姆的书。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: This is ___ room.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：这是孩子们的房间。
questions.explanation: children是不以s结尾的复数名词，所有格加's→children's。规则：不以s结尾的复数名词加's（children→children's, men→men's）。选项A(childrens')错误，因为children本身已是复数，不以s结尾应加's而非'；选项C和D无所有格形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词所有格：不以s结尾的复数名词加's
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这是孩子们的房间。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The ___ (teachers) office is on the second floor.
questions.questionCn: 填空：老师们的办公室在二楼。
questions.explanation: teachers是以s结尾的复数名词，所有格只加'→teachers'。规则：以s结尾的复数名词只加'（teachers→teachers', students→students'）。对比：不以s结尾的复数加's（women→women's）。名词所有格总结：单数+'s；以s结尾的复数+'；不以s结尾的复数+'s。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词所有格：以s结尾的复数只加'
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老师们的办公室在二楼。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: This is not my book. It's ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：这不是我的书。是她的。
questions.explanation: 名词性物主代词hers=her book，可独立使用，后面不加名词。'It's hers'=It's her book。物主代词分两种：①形容词性（my, your, his, her, its, our, their）需接名词；②名词性（mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs）可独立使用。选项A(her)是形容词性需接名词；选项C(she's)=she is，含义不对。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词性物主代词：hers=her book
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这不是我的书。是她的。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ are good students.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们是好学生。
questions.explanation: 作主语时用人称代词主格We。人称代词主格（作主语）：I, you, he, she, it, we, they。宾格（作宾语）：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。'We are good students'中We作主语用主格。选项A(Us)是宾格不能作主语；选项C(Our)和D(Ours)是物主代词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 人称代词主格：作主语用主格
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们是好学生。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Please give ___ (I) the book.
questions.questionCn: 填空：请把书给我。
questions.explanation: 作宾语时用人称代词宾格。give sb sth中sb是间接宾语，用宾格me。I的宾格是me。人称代词宾格（作宾语）：me, you, him, her, it, us, them。主格和宾格的选择取决于在句中充当的成分：主语用主格(I)，宾语用宾格(me)。
questions.knowledgePoint: 人称代词宾格：作宾语用宾格
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请把书给我。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: She can take care of ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她能照顾自己。
questions.explanation: 当主语和宾语是同一人时，用反身代词。She和宾语指同一人，用herself。反身代词：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。'take care of herself'=照顾她自己。选项A(her)是宾格，不能表示'她自己'；选项C(hers)是名词性物主代词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 反身代词：主宾同指用反身代词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她能照顾自己。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The children enjoyed ___ at the party.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: enjoy oneself表示'玩得开心'，是固定搭配。children是复数，用themselves。enjoy oneself=have a good time。反身代词的常见搭配：enjoy oneself（玩得开心）, help oneself to（自取）, teach oneself（自学）, hurt oneself（受伤）, by oneself（独自）。
questions.knowledgePoint: enjoy oneself：固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I taught ___ (I) to play the piano.
questions.questionCn: 填空：我自学弹钢琴。
questions.explanation: teach oneself表示'自学'，是固定搭配。主语I与宾语指同一人，用反身代词myself。'I taught myself to play the piano'=我自学弹钢琴。teach oneself=learn by oneself。反身代词由形容词性物主代词+self/selves构成：my+self=myself, our+selves=ourselves。
questions.knowledgePoint: teach oneself：自学
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我自学弹钢琴。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I have ___ to tell you.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我有重要的事要告诉你。
questions.explanation: 不定代词(something, anything, nothing, everything)的修饰语放在后面。'something important'中important修饰something，放在后面。肯定句用something。选项B(important something)修饰语位置错误，应放后面；选项C(anything)用于否定/疑问句；选项D结构不对。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不定代词：修饰语后置
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我有重要的事要告诉你。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Is there ___ in the room?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：房间里有人吗？
questions.explanation: 疑问句中用anyone表示'任何人'。'Is there anyone in the room?'是疑问句，用anyone。someone用于肯定句表示'某人'；anyone用于否定/疑问句。some-系列用于肯定，any-系列用于否定/疑问。但表示请求/邀请时可用some-：Would you like something to drink?
questions.knowledgePoint: 不定代词：疑问句用anyone
questions.sentenceTranslation: 房间里有人吗？

questions.question: True or False: 'Everyone are here.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'Everyone are here.' 语法正确。
questions.explanation: 此句错误。不定代词everyone, someone, anyone, nobody等虽然表示'每个人'的意思，但在语法上视为单数，谓语动词用单数。正确形式：'Everyone is here.' 类似的复合不定代词（-body, -one结尾的）都视为单数：somebody is, nobody is, everybody is。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不定代词：everyone等视为单数
questions.sentenceTranslation: 每个人都在这里。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Tom is ___ than Jack.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：汤姆比杰克高。
questions.explanation: 比较级用于两者之间的比较，结构：比较级+than。tall是单音节形容词，比较级直接加er→taller。'Tom is taller than Jack'表示汤姆比杰克高。选项A(tall)是原级；选项C(tallest)是最高级；选项D(more tall)错误，单音节词不加more。比较级规则：单音节加er；多音节加more。
questions.knowledgePoint: 比较级：单音节加er+than
questions.sentenceTranslation: 汤姆比杰克高。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: She is the ___ student in our class.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她是我们班最聪明的学生。
questions.explanation: 最高级用于三者或以上的比较，结构：the+最高级+of/in。smart是单音节形容词，最高级加est→smartest，前面加the。'the smartest student in our class'表示班里最聪明的学生。选项A是原级；选项B是比较级；选项D错误，单音节不加most。
questions.knowledgePoint: 最高级：单音节加est，前加the
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她是我们班最聪明的学生。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: This problem is ___ (difficult) than that one.
questions.questionCn: 填空：这个问题比那个问题更难。
questions.explanation: difficult是多音节形容词（三个音节），比较级加more→more difficult。多音节形容词比较级加more，最高级加most。规则总结：单音节加er/est（tall→taller→tallest）；多音节加more/most（beautiful→more beautiful→most beautiful）；双音节以y结尾变ier/iest（happy→happier→happiest）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 比较级：多音节加more
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这个问题比那个问题更难。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: She sings ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她唱歌很好听。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词sing应用副词beautifully。形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词/形容词/其他副词。'She sings beautifully'中beautifully修饰动词sings。选项A(beautiful)是形容词修饰名词；选项C(beauty)是名词；选项D是比较级。区分：形容词修饰名词（a beautiful song）；副词修饰动词（sings beautifully）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 副词修饰动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她唱歌很好听。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He is a ___ driver.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：他是一个细心的司机。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词driver应用形容词careful。形容词修饰名词，放在名词前。'a careful driver'中careful修饰名词driver。选项B(carefully)是副词修饰动词；选项C(care)是名词/动词；选项D(carefulness)是名词。区分：形容词修饰名词（careful driver）；副词修饰动词（drives carefully）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词修饰名词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是一个细心的司机。

questions.question: True or False: 'He runs fast.' and 'He is a fast runner.' both use 'fast' correctly.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'He runs fast.' 和 'He is a fast runner.' 中的fast使用都正确。
questions.explanation: 正确。fast既是形容词也是副词，形式相同。'He runs fast'中fast作副词修饰动词runs；'He is a fast runner'中fast作形容词修饰名词runner。有些词既是形容词也是副词（形副同形）：fast, hard, early, late, high等。注意：hardly是副词但意为'几乎不'，与hard（努力地）含义不同。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形副同形：fast既是形容词也是副词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他跑得很快。/他是一个跑得快的运动员。

questions.question: Choose the correct article: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：我在动物园看到了一头大象。
questions.explanation: an用于元音音素开头的单词前。elephant以元音音素/e/开头，用an。a/an的选择取决于发音而非拼写：元音音素开头用an，辅音音素开头用a。选项A(a)用于辅音音素开头；选项C(the)是定冠词表特指；选项D表示零冠词。an elephant, an apple, an hour（h不发音）。
questions.knowledgePoint: an用于元音音素开头的词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我在动物园看到了一头大象。

questions.question: Choose the correct article: He is ___ university student.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：他是一名大学生。
questions.explanation: university虽然以u开头，但u发/juː/（辅音音素/j/），用a。a/an的选择取决于发音：university以辅音音素/j/开头，用a。对比：umbrella以/ʌ/开头（元音音素），用an umbrella。类似用a的：a useful tool, a European country, a one-way street（以辅音音素/w/开头）。
questions.knowledgePoint: a/an取决于发音而非拼写
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他是一名大学生。

questions.question: True or False: 'I waited for an hour.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'I waited for an hour.' 语法正确。
questions.explanation: 正确。hour中h不发音，以元音音素/aʊ/开头，用an。'an hour'是正确的。a/an的选择取决于开头的音素而非字母：an hour（h不发音→元音音素），an honest man（h不发音）。对比：a house（h发音→辅音音素），a hero（h发音）。这是中国学生容易出错的地方——看字母而非听发音。
questions.knowledgePoint: an用于不发音h开头的词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我等了一个小时。

questions.question: Choose the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：太阳从东方升起。
questions.explanation: 世界上独一无二的事物前用the。the sun（太阳）, the moon（月亮）, the earth（地球）, the sky（天空）等都是独一无二的事物，用the。'The sun rises in the east'中sun和east都是独一无二的事物，都用the。选项A和B是不定冠词表泛指；选项D零冠词不用于独一无二事物。
questions.knowledgePoint: the用于独一无二的事物
questions.sentenceTranslation: 太阳从东方升起。

questions.question: Choose the correct article: Please pass me ___ book on the table.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：请把桌子上的那本书递给我。
questions.explanation: 特指某物时用the。'the book on the table'特指桌子上的那本书（有后置定语on the table限定）。the表示特指——说话人和听话人都知道指哪个。选项A(a)表泛指'一本书'，不符合特指语境。the的用法：①特指；②独一无二；③上文提到过；④序数词/最高级前；⑤the+adj表一类人。
questions.knowledgePoint: the表示特指
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请把桌子上的那本书递给我。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ Yellow River is the second longest river in China.
questions.questionCn: 填空：黄河是中国第二长河。
questions.explanation: 河流名称前用the。the Yellow River（黄河）, the Yangtze River（长江）, the Nile（尼罗河）等河流名前都用the。the的用法总结：①河流、海洋、山脉、群岛等地理名称前（the Pacific, the Himalayas）；②乐器名称前（play the piano）；③某些国家名称（the United States, the UK）；④朝代/时代前（the Tang Dynasty）。
questions.knowledgePoint: the用于河流名称前
questions.sentenceTranslation: 黄河是中国第二长河。

gm_083.grammarName: 零冠词（不用冠词的情况）

questions.category: 零冠词（不用冠词的情况）
questions.question: Choose the correct article: I like playing ___ basketball.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：我喜欢打篮球。
questions.explanation: 球类运动前不用冠词（零冠词）。'play basketball'不加the。球类/棋类运动前用零冠词：play football, play tennis, play chess。但乐器前用the：play the piano, play the guitar。区分：球类运动零冠词，乐器用the。选项C(the)错误用于球类运动前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 零冠词：球类运动前不加冠词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我喜欢打篮球。

questions.category: 零冠词（不用冠词的情况）
questions.question: Choose the correct article: ___ breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的冠词：早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。
questions.explanation: 三餐前不用冠词（零冠词）。breakfast, lunch, dinner/supper前用零冠词。'Breakfast is the most important meal'中breakfast前不加冠词。零冠词的用法：①三餐前；②球类运动前；③学科前（study English）；④节假日/月份/星期前；⑤泛指复数名词/不可数名词前；⑥称呼/头衔前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 零冠词：三餐前不加冠词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐。

questions.category: 零冠词（不用冠词的情况）
questions.question: True or False: 'She goes to school by the bus.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'She goes to school by the bus.' 语法正确。
questions.explanation: 此句错误。by+交通工具表示出行方式时不用冠词。正确形式：'She goes to school by bus.' by bus（乘公交）, by car（开车）, by bike（骑车）, by train（乘火车）, by plane（乘飞机）都不加冠词。但'.take the bus'中要加the（take the bus = 乘公交）。区分：by+交通工具零冠词；take+the+交通工具要加the。
questions.knowledgePoint: 零冠词：by+交通工具不加冠词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她乘公交车上学。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: I was born ___ January.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：我出生在一月。
questions.explanation: in用于月份前。时间介词in/on/at的用法：in用于较长的时间段（年、月、季节：in 2020, in January, in spring）；on用于具体的某天或某天的部分（on Monday, on July 1st, on Monday morning）；at用于具体的时间点（at 8 o'clock, at noon, at night）。January是月份，用in。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时间介词in：用于月份
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我出生在一月。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: We will meet ___ Monday morning.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：我们将在周一早上见面。
questions.explanation: on用于具体某天的上下午/晚上。'on Monday morning'中Monday是具体某天，其morning部分也用on。规则：in the morning/afternoon/evening（无具体某天用in）；on Monday morning（有具体某天用on）；at night（用at）。选项A(in)用于无具体某天的上下午。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时间介词on：具体某天的上下午
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们将在周一早上见面。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The meeting starts ___ 3 o'clock.
questions.questionCn: 填空：会议三点开始。
questions.explanation: at用于具体的时间点。3 o'clock是具体时间点，用at。时间介词in/on/at总结：in用于时间段（年in 2020、月in May、季节in summer）；on用于具体某天（on Sunday, on May 1st, on weekend）；at用于时间点（at 3 o'clock, at noon, at midnight, at the weekend英式）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时间介词at：用于时间点
questions.sentenceTranslation: 会议三点开始。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She lives ___ Beijing.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：她住在北京。
questions.explanation: in用于较大的地点（城市、国家、洲）。Beijing是城市，用in。地点介词in/on/at的用法：in用于较大的空间（城市in Beijing、国家in China、房间in the room）；on用于表面/线上（on the table, on the wall, on the street）；at用于具体的点（at the door, at the bus stop, at school）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 地点介词in：用于大城市/国家
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她住在北京。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: The picture is ___ the wall.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：画在墙上。
questions.explanation: on表示在表面/附着在表面上。picture挂在墙的表面上，用on。on the wall（在墙上）, on the table（在桌上）, on the floor（在地板上）。in the wall表示'在墙里面'（如洞）。区分：on the wall（挂在墙表面）vs in the wall（嵌入墙内）；on the tree（长在树上，如苹果）vs in the tree（在树枝间，如鸟）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 地点介词on：在表面
questions.sentenceTranslation: 画在墙上。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She is waiting ___ the bus stop.
questions.questionCn: 填空：她在公交站等着。
questions.explanation: at用于具体的地点（点状位置）。bus stop是具体的点状位置，用at。地点介词in/on/at总结：in用于大空间（in China, in the room）；on用于表面（on the table, on the wall）；at用于具体点（at the door, at school, at home, at the bus stop）。at强调'在某一点'，in强调'在里面'，on强调'在表面'。
questions.knowledgePoint: 地点介词at：用于具体地点
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她在公交站等着。

questions.question: Choose the correct conjunction: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的连词：我想出去，但是在下雨。
questions.explanation: but是并列连词，表转折'但是'。想出去和下雨是转折关系。并列连词连接平等的分句：and（并列）, but（转折）, or（选择）, so（因果）, for（原因）。选项A(and)表并列/递进，不表转折；选项C(because)是从属连词引导原因从句；选项D(so)表因果。but连接两个独立的分句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 并列连词but：表转折
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我想出去，但是在下雨。

questions.question: Which of the following is a subordinating conjunction?
questions.questionCn: 以下哪个是从属连词？
questions.explanation: although是从属连词，引导让步状语从句。从属连词引导从句，使从句依附于主句。常见从属连词：although（虽然）, because（因为）, if（如果）, when（当）, while（当……时）, since（自从/因为）, unless（除非）等。并列连词(and, but, or, so)连接平等的分句；从属连词引导从句，主从句不平等。选项A、B、D都是并列连词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 从属连词：引导从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: although是从属连词。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Hurry up, ___ you will miss the bus.
questions.questionCn: 填空：快点，否则你会错过公交车。
questions.explanation: or作并列连词，在祈使句后表示'否则'。'Hurry up, or you will miss the bus'表示快点，否则会错过公交车。or在此意为'否则'。并列连词总结：and（和/然后）, but（但是）, or（或者/否则）, so（所以）, for（因为）。祈使句+or表示'否则'：Study hard, or you will fail. 祈使句+and表示'就'：Study hard, and you will pass.
questions.knowledgePoint: 并列连词or：祈使句后表'否则'
questions.sentenceTranslation: 快点，否则你会错过公交车。

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: Please ___ your homework.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的动词：请做你的作业。
questions.explanation: do homework是固定搭配，表示'做作业'。do常用于日常活动/任务：do homework（做作业）, do housework（做家务）, do exercises（做练习）, do business（做生意）, do one's best（尽力）。make强调创造/制造：make a cake（做蛋糕）, make a mistake（犯错）, make money（赚钱）, make a decision（做决定）。
questions.knowledgePoint: do搭配：do homework做作业
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请做你的作业。

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: He ___ a lot of money last year.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的动词：他去年赚了很多钱。

questions.knowledgePoint: make搭配：make money赚钱
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他去年赚了很多钱。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: She ___ a mistake in the exam. (用make或do的正确形式)
questions.questionCn: 填空：她在考试中犯了一个错误。
questions.explanation: make a mistake是固定搭配，表示'犯错'。此句是过去时（in the exam暗示已发生），make的过去式是made。make与do的区分总结：make创造/产生新事物（make a cake, make a plan, make money, make a decision）；do执行/完成活动（do homework, do housework, do exercises, do one's best）。
questions.knowledgePoint: make搭配：make a mistake犯错
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她在考试中犯了一个错误。

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: Please ___ a seat.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的动词：请坐下。
questions.explanation: take a seat是固定搭配，表示'坐下'。take常用于：take a seat（坐下）, take a bus（乘公交）, take medicine（吃药）, take a photo（拍照）, take time（花时间）, take a shower（洗澡）。get常用于：get up（起床）, get dressed（穿衣服）, get ready（准备好）, get lost（迷路）。
questions.knowledgePoint: take搭配：take a seat坐下
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请坐下。

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: I usually ___ up at 7 o'clock.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的动词：我通常7点起床。
questions.explanation: get up是固定搭配，表示'起床'。get常用于状态变化/获得：get up（起床）, get dressed（穿好衣服）, get angry（生气）, get better（好转）, get a letter（收到信）, get married（结婚）。take更多表示动作/获取：take a bus, take a break, take medicine。区分：get强调状态变化或获得；take强调动作。
questions.knowledgePoint: get搭配：get up起床
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我通常7点起床。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It ___ me two hours to finish the work. (用take的正确形式)
questions.questionCn: 填空：我花了两个小时完成这项工作。
questions.explanation: It takes sb+时间+to do sth是固定句型，表示'做某事花了某人多少时间'。此句是过去时（已完成的工作），take的过去式是took。take的常见搭配：take time（花时间）, take a bus（乘公交）, take medicine（吃药）, take a photo（拍照）, take care of（照顾）, take part in（参加）。
questions.knowledgePoint: take搭配：It takes sb time to do sth
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我花了两个小时完成这项工作。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: She is good ___ math.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：她擅长数学。
questions.explanation: be good at是固定搭配，表示'擅长……'。'She is good at math'表示她擅长数学。常见介词固定搭配：be good at（擅长）, be afraid of（害怕）, be interested in（对……感兴趣）, be famous for（因……出名）, be angry with（生……的气）, be proud of（为……骄傲）, be different from（与……不同）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词搭配：be good at擅长
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她擅长数学。

questions.question: Choose the correct preposition: I am interested ___ history.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的介词：我对历史感兴趣。
questions.explanation: be interested in是固定搭配，表示'对……感兴趣'。'I am interested in history'表示我对历史感兴趣。介词搭配需记忆，不能随意替换。常见搭配：be interested in（对……感兴趣）, be afraid of（害怕）, be good at（擅长）, be kind to（对……友好）, be strict with（对……严格）, be satisfied with（对……满意）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词搭配：be interested in对……感兴趣
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我对历史感兴趣。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他怕狗。
questions.explanation: be afraid of是固定搭配，表示'害怕……'。'He is afraid of dogs'表示他怕狗。常见介词固定搭配总结：be afraid of（害怕）, be good at（擅长）, be interested in（感兴趣）, be angry with（生气的）, be proud of（骄傲）, be different from（不同）, be full of（充满）, be tired of（厌倦）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词搭配：be afraid of害怕
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他怕狗。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: The weather is getting ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：天气变冷了。
questions.explanation: get+形容词表示'变得……'（状态变化）。'getting cold'表示天气变冷了。get的常见短语：get up（起床）, get over（克服/恢复）, get along (with)（与……相处）, get rid of（摆脱）, get away（逃离）, get back（回来/取回）, get in（进入/到达）, get off（下车）。
questions.knowledgePoint: get短语：get+adj变得
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气变冷了。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: How do you ___ with your classmates?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：你和同学相处得怎么样？
questions.explanation: get along (with)表示'与……相处'。'How do you get along with your classmates?'表示你和同学相处得怎样。get along with sb=与某人相处融洽。选项A(get up)表示起床；选项B(get over)表示克服/从疾病中恢复；选项D(get back)表示回来/取回。get短语动词的含义取决于后面的副词/介词。
questions.knowledgePoint: get短语：get along with相处

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It took him a long time to get ___ his illness. (填入适当的副词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：他花了很长时间才从疾病中恢复过来。
questions.explanation: get over表示'从疾病/困难中恢复/克服'。'get over his illness'表示从疾病中恢复。get短语总结：get up（起床）, get over（克服/恢复）, get along (with)（相处）, get rid of（摆脱）, get back（回来）, get off（下车）, get in（进入/到达）, get away（逃离）, get to（到达）。
questions.knowledgePoint: get短语：get over恢复/克服
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他花了很长时间才从疾病中恢复过来。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: Please ___ your coat. It's cold outside.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：请穿上外套。外面很冷。
questions.explanation: put on表示'穿上'（穿戴动作）。'put on your coat'表示穿上外套。注意：take off表示'脱下'，与put on相反。take的常见短语：take off（脱下/起飞）, take after（像/相似）, take care of（照顾）, take part in（参加）, take place（发生）, take out（取出）, take back（收回）。
questions.knowledgePoint: take短语：take off脱下/起飞
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请穿上外套。外面很冷。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: She really ___ her mother.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：她真的很像她妈妈。
questions.explanation: take after表示'（长相/性格）像（某位长辈）'。'She takes after her mother'表示她像她妈妈。take after专指与父母/祖辈相似。选项B(takes off)表示脱下/起飞；选项C(takes care)需接of表示照顾；选项D(takes part)需接in表示参加。
questions.knowledgePoint: take短语：take after像
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她真的很像她妈妈。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The meeting will take ___ tomorrow morning. (填入适当的副词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：会议将于明天早上举行。
questions.explanation: take place表示'发生/举行'。'The meeting will take place tomorrow'表示会议明天举行。take place是不及物动词短语，没有被动语态。take短语总结：take off（脱下/起飞）, take after（像）, take care of（照顾）, take part in（参加）, take place（发生/举行）, take out（取出）, take back（收回）。
questions.knowledgePoint: take短语：take place发生/举行
questions.sentenceTranslation: 会议将于明天早上举行。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: Please ___ your books on the desk.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：请把书放在桌子上。
questions.explanation: put down表示'放下'。'put down your books'表示把书放下/放在桌上。put的常见短语：put on（穿上/上演）, put off（推迟）, put up（搭建/张贴）, put down（放下/写下）, put away（收好）, put out（熄灭）, put forward（提出）, put up with（忍受）。
questions.knowledgePoint: put短语：put down放下
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请把书放在桌子上。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: Don't ___ the meeting until next week.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：不要把会议推迟到下周。
questions.explanation: put off表示'推迟'。'Don't put off the meeting'表示不要推迟会议。put off sth=推迟某事，后接名词或动名词：put off the meeting / put off doing sth。选项A(put on)表示穿上；选项C(put up)表示搭建；选项D(put away)表示收好。put短语的含义取决于后面的副词。
questions.knowledgePoint: put短语：put off推迟
questions.sentenceTranslation: 不要把会议推迟到下周。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Please put ___ the fire before you leave. (填入适当的副词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：离开前请把火熄灭。
questions.explanation: put out表示'熄灭'。'put out the fire'表示熄灭火。put短语总结：put on（穿上/上演）, put off（推迟）, put up（搭建/张贴/举起）, put down（放下/写下）, put away（收好）, put out（熄灭）, put forward（提出）, put up with（忍受）。每个短语的意思取决于副词。
questions.knowledgePoint: put短语：put out熄灭
questions.sentenceTranslation: 离开前请把火熄灭。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: Could you ___ my cat while I'm away?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：我不在时你能照顾我的猫吗？
questions.explanation: look after表示'照顾/照料'。'look after my cat'表示照顾我的猫。look的常见短语：look after（照顾）, look for（寻找）, look at（看）, look up（查阅/仰望）, look out（小心/注意）, look forward to（期待）, look into（调查）, look over（检查）, look down on（看不起）。
questions.knowledgePoint: look短语：look after照顾
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我不在时你能照顾我的猫吗？

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: I am ___ to seeing you again.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：我期待再次见到你。
questions.explanation: look forward to表示'期待'，注意to是介词，后接名词或动名词。'looking forward to seeing you'中to后接动名词seeing。look forward to doing sth=期待做某事。选项B(looking for)表示寻找；选项C(looking after)表示照顾；选项D(looking at)表示看。look forward to中的to是介词不是不定式符号。
questions.knowledgePoint: look短语：look forward to期待（to是介词）

questions.question: Fill in the blank: What are you looking ___? (你找什么？填入适当介词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：你在找什么？
questions.explanation: look for表示'寻找'。'What are you looking for?'表示你在找什么。look短语总结：look after（照顾）, look for（寻找）, look at（看）, look up（查阅）, look out（小心）, look forward to（期待）, look into（调查）, look over（检查）, look down on（看不起）, look up to（尊敬）。
questions.knowledgePoint: look短语：look for寻找
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你在找什么？

gm_094.grammarName: it的用法（形式主语/形式宾语/强调用法）

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: ___ is important to learn English well.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的句子：学好英语很重要。
questions.explanation: it作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式短语to learn English well。当真正的主语较长（不定式、动名词或从句）时，常用it作形式主语放在句首，避免头重脚轻。句型：It is + adj. + to do sth。选项A(That)不能引导这种结构；选项C(This)在此结构中不用；选项D(What)引导名词性从句，不用于此结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: it作形式主语：It is adj. to do sth
questions.sentenceTranslation: 学好英语很重要。

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: I find ___ difficult to finish the work in two days.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的句子：我觉得两天内完成这项工作很困难。
questions.explanation: it作形式宾语，真正的宾语是后面的不定式to finish the work in two days。当宾语是不定式、动名词或从句且带有宾语补足语（如difficult）时，常用it作形式宾语放在宾语位置，把真正宾语后移。句型：主语 + find/make/think + it + adj. + to do sth。选项A(that)不能作形式宾语；选项B(this)不用作形式宾语；选项D(its)是物主代词，不能单独作宾语。
questions.knowledgePoint: it作形式宾语：find/make/think it adj. to do sth
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我觉得两天内完成这项工作很困难。

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: It was Tom ___ broke the window yesterday.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的句子：就是Tom昨天打破了窗户。
questions.explanation: 这是it的强调句型：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他部分。强调人时可用that或who，强调物或时间状语等用that。本句强调主语Tom，可用that或who。句型：It is/was + 被强调成分 + that/who...。注意强调句的判断方法：去掉It is/was和that后，句子仍完整通顺。选项C(which)不用于强调句。
questions.knowledgePoint: it的强调句型：It is/was...that/who...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 就是Tom昨天打破了窗户。

questions.question: He said, 'I am reading a book.' Change to indirect speech: He said that ___ reading a book.
questions.questionCn: 他说：'我在读书。'改为间接引语：他说他在读书。
questions.explanation: 直接引语变间接引语时，时态要往回退一步：现在进行时am reading变为过去进行时was reading。同时人称也要变化：第一人称I变为与主句主语一致的he。直接引语中的am（现在时）变为was（过去时）。选项A(he is)时态没变；选项C(I am)人称和时态都没变；选项D(I was)人称没变。
questions.knowledgePoint: 间接引语：时态后退一步，人称随主句变化
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他说他在读书。

questions.question: She said, 'I will go to Beijing tomorrow.' Change to indirect speech: She said that she would go to Beijing ___.
questions.questionCn: 她说：'我明天要去北京。'改为间接引语：她说她第二天要去北京。
questions.explanation: 直接引语变间接引语时，时间状语也要变化：tomorrow变为the next day（第二天）。同时will变为would（时态后退）。常见时间状语变化：now→then，today→that day，tomorrow→the next day，yesterday→the day before，ago→before。选项A(tomorrow)没变；选项C(next day)缺冠词the；选项D(today)错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: 间接引语：时间状语变化tomorrow→the next day
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她说她第二天要去北京。

questions.question: True or False: When changing 'She said, "I like apples."' to indirect speech, it becomes 'She said that she liked apples.'
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：将'She said, "I like apples."'改为间接引语时，应变为'She said that she liked apples.'
questions.explanation: 正确。直接引语变间接引语时，一般现在时like变为一般过去时liked（时态后退一步），第一人称I变为she（人称随主句主语变化），引号去掉并加that引导宾语从句。'She said that she liked apples.'完全符合间接引语的转换规则。
questions.knowledgePoint: 间接引语：一般现在时变一般过去时，人称随主句变化
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她说她喜欢苹果。

questions.question: Choose the correct imperative: ___ the door, please.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的祈使句：请关门。
questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，主语you通常省略。'Close the door, please.'表示请求关门。祈使句的肯定形式直接用动词原形，加please使语气更礼貌。选项A(Open)意为开门，与语境不符；选项C(Closing)是-ing形式不能用于祈使句；选项D(To close)是不定式不能用于祈使句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 祈使句肯定形式：动词原形开头
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请关门。

questions.question: Choose the correct negative imperative: ___ play in the street. It's dangerous.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的否定祈使句：不要在街上玩耍，很危险。
questions.explanation: 祈使句的否定形式是在动词原形前加Don't（Do not）。'Don't play in the street.'表示不要在街上玩。祈使句否定形式：Don't + 动词原形。选项A(Not)不能单独构成否定祈使句；选项C(No)用于No + 名词/V-ing形式（如No smoking）；选项D(Doesn't)是第三人称单数否定，不用于祈使句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 祈使句否定形式：Don't + 动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 不要在街上玩耍，很危险。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (not be) late for school next time. (下次上学别迟到了)
questions.questionCn: 填空：下次上学别迟到了。
questions.explanation: 祈使句否定形式：Don't + 动词原形。be动词的祈使句否定形式是Don't be。'Don't be late for school.'表示别迟到。注意：祈使句中be的否定不能用isn't/aren't，只能用Don't be。let引导的祈使句如Let's go，其否定形式为Let's not go。
questions.knowledgePoint: 祈使句否定：Don't be + 形容词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 下次上学别迟到了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: When I arrived, he ___ for two hours.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：我到的时候，他已经等了两个小时了。
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时表示在过去某个时间点之前，一直持续进行的动作，且可能还在继续。结构：had been + 动词ing。'had been waiting for two hours'强调从我到达之前开始一直持续等待了两个小时。与过去完成时(had waited)的区别在于：过去完成进行时强调动作的持续性。选项A(waited)一般过去时；选项B(was waiting)过去进行时，不表完成；选项C(had waited)过去完成时，强调完成不强调持续过程。
questions.knowledgePoint: 过去完成进行时：had been + doing，强调持续到过去某时
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我到的时候，他已经等了两个小时了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: She ___ English for five years before she went to America.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：去美国之前她已经学了五年英语了。
questions.explanation: 过去完成进行时had been studying强调在去美国之前，学习英语这个动作持续了五年。结构：had been + 动词ing。'before she went to America'是过去时间参照点，在此之前持续发生的动作用过去完成进行时。选项A(studied)一般过去时不能表示持续到过去某时；选项B(has studied)现在完成时，参照点是现在；选项D(was studying)过去进行时，不表时间段。
questions.knowledgePoint: 过去完成进行时：had been doing + for + 时间段
questions.sentenceTranslation: 去美国之前她已经学了五年英语了。

questions.question: True or False: 'They had been working when the boss came in.' correctly uses the past perfect continuous tense.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'They had been working when the boss came in.'正确使用了过去完成进行时。
questions.explanation: 正确。had been working是过去完成进行时，结构为had been + 动词ing。表示在老板进来这个过去时间点之前，他们一直在工作。过去完成进行时强调动作从更早的过去开始，一直持续到另一个过去时间点。'when the boss came in'提供了过去时间参照点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 过去完成进行时：had been doing表示过去某时前持续的动作
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老板进来时他们一直在工作。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: This time tomorrow, I ___ an exam.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：明天这个时候我正在考试。
questions.explanation: 将来进行时表示在将来某个具体时间点正在进行的动作。结构：will be + 动词ing。'will be taking an exam'强调明天这个时候正在考试。'This time tomorrow'是将来具体时间点标志。选项A(will take)一般将来时不强调进行；选项C(take)一般现在时；选项D(am taking)现在进行时，不能表示将来。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来进行时：will be doing，表将来某时正在做
questions.sentenceTranslation: 明天这个时候我正在考试。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: At 8 PM tonight, she ___ for her flight.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：今晚8点她将正在等她的航班。
questions.explanation: 将来进行时will be waiting强调在今晚8点这个将来具体时间点正在等待。结构：will be + 动词ing。'At 8 PM tonight'是将来具体时间点。将来进行时比will do更具体地描述将来某一时刻正在发生的动作，画面感更强。选项A(will wait)不强调进行；选项C(waits)一般现在时；选项D(waited)一般过去时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来进行时：will be doing + 将来时间点
questions.sentenceTranslation: 今晚8点她将正在等她的航班。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Don't call me at 10 tomorrow. I ___ (have) a meeting then.
questions.questionCn: 填空：明天10点别给我打电话，那时我正在开会。
questions.explanation: 将来进行时will be having强调明天10点正在开会。结构：will be + 动词ing。'at 10 tomorrow'和'then'都指将来的具体时间点。将来进行时表示在将来某时正在进行的动作。比will have更强调那个时刻正在进行的状态。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来进行时：will be doing表将来某时刻正在进行
questions.sentenceTranslation: 明天10点别给我打电话，那时我正在开会。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: By the end of next year, I ___ this project.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：到明年年底，我将完成这个项目。
questions.explanation: 将来完成时表示在将来某个截止时间之前已经完成的动作。结构：will have + 过去分词。'will have finished'表示到明年年底已经完成项目。'By the end of next year'是将来截止时间标志，by表示'到...为止'。选项A(will finish)一般将来时不强调完成；选项C(finish)一般现在时；选项D(have finished)现在完成时，参照点是现在而非将来。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来完成时：will have done + by + 将来时间
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到明年年底，我将完成这个项目。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: By the time you arrive, we ___ dinner.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：到你到达时，我们将已经吃完晚饭了。
questions.explanation: 将来完成时will have eaten表示在你到达之前晚饭已经吃完。结构：will have + 过去分词。'By the time you arrive'表示将来的截止时间点。将来完成时强调在将来某时之前已经完成的动作。选项A(will eat)不强调完成；选项C(ate)一般过去时；选项D(are eating)现在进行时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来完成时：will have done + by the time + 将来
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到你到达时，我们将已经吃完晚饭了。

questions.question: True or False: 'By next month, she will have worked here for ten years.' correctly uses the future perfect tense.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'By next month, she will have worked here for ten years.'正确使用了将来完成时。
questions.explanation: 正确。will have worked是将来完成时，结构为will have + 过去分词。表示到下个月为止，她在这里工作将满十年。'By next month'是将来的截止时间标志，'for ten years'表示持续的时间段。将来完成时常与by引导的时间状语连用，强调到将来某时为止已经完成或持续了多久的动作。
questions.knowledgePoint: 将来完成时：will have done + by + 将来时间
questions.sentenceTranslation: 到下个月，她在这里工作将满十年。

gm_100.grammarName: 一般将来时的其他表达（be about to/be to/shall）

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Hurry up! The train is about to ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：快点！火车马上就要开了。
questions.explanation: be about to do表示'马上就要做某事'，强调即将发生，后面接动词原形。'is about to leave'表示火车即将离开。be about to通常不与具体的时间状语连用，因为它本身已含有'马上、即将'之意。选项B(leaving)错误，be about to后接原形；选项C(left)过去式错误；选项D(leaves)第三人称单数错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: be about to do：马上就要做某事
questions.sentenceTranslation: 快点！火车马上就要开了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The President ___ to visit China next week.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：总统下周将访问中国。
questions.explanation: be to do表示按计划、安排将要发生的事，常用于正式场合、新闻中。'is to visit'表示按计划将访问。be to do表示'计划/安排/命令/注定'要做某事，比will更正式。选项A(will)虽可表示将来但不如is to正式；选项B(is)缺少to，不完整；选项D(is about to)表示马上就要，而next week不是马上，时间不匹配。
questions.knowledgePoint: be to do：按计划/安排将要做某事
questions.sentenceTranslation: 总统下周将访问中国。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I ___ (shall) return the book to you tomorrow. (第一人称，正式场合)
questions.questionCn: 填空：我明天将把书还给你。
questions.explanation: shall用于第一人称（I/we）表示将来时，多用于正式场合或英国英语中。'shall return'表示我将归还。在现代英语中shall已较少使用，多被will替代，但在正式文体中仍保留。shall还可用于第一人称的征求意见（Shall we go?）。注意：shall在第二、第三人称中表示命令/允诺/威胁。
questions.knowledgePoint: shall用于第一人称表将来（正式）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我明天将把书还给你。

gm_101.grammarName: 被动语态的特殊用法（It is said that等）

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: ___ that he is a great scientist.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的句子：据说他是一位伟大的科学家。
questions.explanation: It is said that...表示'据说...'，是被动语态的固定句式。it是形式主语，真正主语是that从句。类似的句式还有：It is reported that（据报道）, It is believed that（人们相信）, It is known that（众所周知）, It is estimated that（据估计）。选项B(It says)是主动语态，不用于此句式；选项C(It is saying)现在进行时错误；选项D(It said)时态错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: It is said that...：据说（形式主语+被动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他是一位伟大的科学家。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He is said ___ a new novel.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：据说他正在写一本新小说。
questions.explanation: sb is said to do表示'据说某人做某事'，是It is said that sb does sth的简化形式。当原句是进行时态时，用to be doing。'is said to be writing'对应It is said that he is writing a new novel。时态对应：一般时→to do，进行时→to be doing，完成时→to have done。选项A(to write)对应一般时；选项C(writing)缺to；选项D(to writing)结构错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: sb is said to do/be doing：据说某人做/正在做
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他正在写一本新小说。

questions.question: True or False: 'It is reported that three people were injured in the accident.' is grammatically correct.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'It is reported that three people were injured in the accident.'语法正确。
questions.explanation: 正确。It is reported that...表示'据报道...'，是被动语态的固定句式。it是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。句中were injured也是被动语态（be + 过去分词），表示'受伤'。整个句子结构完整、时态一致，语法正确。
questions.knowledgePoint: It is reported that...：据报道
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据报道，三人在事故中受伤。

gm_102.grammarName: 不能用被动语态的动词

questions.category: 不能用被动语态的动词
questions.question: Which sentence is INCORRECT?
questions.questionCn: 哪个句子是不正确的？
choices: A. She has a beautiful car.
B. A beautiful car is had by her.
C. The shoes fit me well.
questions.explanation: have表示'拥有'时是状态动词，不能用被动语态。'A beautiful car is had by her'是错误的。不能用被动语态的动词包括表示状态的及物动词：have（拥有）, fit（适合）, suit（适合）, resemble（像）, lack（缺少）, cost（花费）, weigh（重）等。这些动词表示状态而非动作，没有被动形式。选项A/C/D都是正确的主动句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 表示状态的及物动词（have/fit/resemble等）不能用被动
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她拥有一辆漂亮的车。

questions.category: 不能用被动语态的动词
questions.question: Which verb can be used in the passive voice?
questions.questionCn: 哪个动词可以用被动语态？
questions.explanation: build（建造）是表示动作的及物动词，可以用被动语态，如'The bridge was built in 1990.'。其他选项都不能用被动：happen（发生）和arrive（到达）是不及物动词，没有宾语，不可能有被动语态；lack（缺少）是状态动词，不能用被动。判断能否用被动：1.必须是及物动词（有宾语）；2.必须表示动作而非状态。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不及物动词和状态动词不能用被动语态
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这座桥建于1990年。

questions.category: 不能用被动语态的动词
questions.question: True or False: 'The book cost me 50 yuan.' can be changed to 'I was cost 50 yuan by the book.'
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'The book cost me 50 yuan.'可以改为被动语态'I was cost 50 yuan by the book.'
questions.explanation: 错误。cost（花费）是表示状态的及物动词，不能用被动语态。'The book cost me 50 yuan.'只能用主动语态，不能变为被动。类似不能用被动的状态动词还有：cost, weigh, measure, last等。这些动词虽然带宾语（及物），但因为表示状态而非动作，所以没有被动形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: cost/weigh/measure等状态动词不能用被动
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这本书花了我50元。

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: This is the best book ___ I have ever read.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的关系代词：这是我读过的最好的书。
questions.explanation: 当先行词被最高级（the best）修饰时，关系代词只能用that，不能用which。这是that和which的重要区别之一。必须用that的情况：1.先行词被最高级修饰；2.先行词被序数词修饰；3.先行词是不定代词（all/anything/nothing等）；4.先行词既指人又指物。选项A(which)在最高级修饰时不能用；选项C(what)不能引导定语从句；选项D(who)指人不用指物。
questions.knowledgePoint: 先行词被最高级修饰时只能用that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这是我读过的最好的书。

questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: He bought a new car, ___ cost him a lot of money.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的关系代词：他买了一辆新车，花了他很多钱。
questions.explanation: 在非限制性定语从句中（有逗号隔开），只能用which，不能用that。'which cost him a lot of money'是修饰前面整个句子或car的非限制性定语从句。that和which的区别：限制性定语从句可用that或which；非限制性定语从句（有逗号）只能用which；介词后只能用which。选项A(that)在非限制性从句中不能用；选项C(what)不引导定语从句；选项D(it)是代词不是关系代词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非限制性定语从句只能用which不能用that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他买了一辆新车，花了他很多钱。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: This is the house in ___ he was born. (填入正确的关系代词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：这是他出生的那座房子。
questions.explanation: 介词后面只能用which，不能用that。'in which'相当于关系副词where。'the house in which he was born'等于'the house where he was born'。that和which的区别之一：介词+关系代词指物时只能用which。如果用that则介词不能放在前面，只能放在后面（the house that he was born in）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词后只能用which不能用that
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这是他出生的那座房子。

gm_104.grammarName: as与which非限制性定语从句区别

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ is known to all, the earth is round.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：众所周知，地球是圆的。
questions.explanation: as引导非限制性定语从句，表示'正如'，可以放在句首、句中或句末。'As is known to all'表示'众所周知'。as和which的区别：as有'正如'的含义，可放句首；which没有'正如'之意，不能放句首，只能放句中或句末。'As is known to all'是固定用法，不能用Which替代。选项A(Which)不能放句首；选项C(That)不引导非限制性定语从句；选项D(It)不是关系代词。
questions.knowledgePoint: as引导非限制性定语从句可放句首（正如）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 众所周知，地球是圆的。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: He passed the exam, ___ made his parents happy.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：他通过了考试，这让他的父母很高兴。
questions.explanation: which引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整个句子（他通过考试这件事），没有'正如'的含义，放在句末。'which made his parents happy'表示这件事让父母高兴。当指代整个主句且没有'正如'之意时用which。as有'正如'之意，本句没有这个意思，所以不用as。选项C(that)不用于非限制性从句；选项D(it)不能连接两个从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: which引导非限制性定语从句指代主句（无正如之意）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他通过了考试，这让他的父母很高兴。

questions.question: True or False: 'As we all know, water is important.' can be replaced by 'Which we all know, water is important.'
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'As we all know, water is important.'可以用'Which we all know, water is important.'替换。
questions.explanation: 错误。as可以放在句首引导非限制性定语从句，表示'正如'，但which不能放在句首。'As we all know'是正确用法，但'Which we all know'是错误的。as与which的区别：as有'正如'的意思，可放句首/句中/句末；which没有'正如'之意，只能放句中或句末，不能放句首。这是两者的关键区别。
questions.knowledgePoint: as可放句首，which不能放句首
questions.sentenceTranslation: 众所周知，水很重要。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ he said is true.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：他所说的是真的。
questions.explanation: what引导主语从句，既当连接词又作从句的宾语（said的宾语），意思是'...的东西/事情'。'What he said'表示'他所说的话'。what与that的区别：that引导名词性从句时不作句子成分，只起连接作用；what必须作成分（主语/宾语/表语）且有实际意义'...的事物'。本句said缺宾语，所以用what。选项A(That)不作成分，said缺宾语不通；选项C(Which)表示'哪个'，不合语境；选项D(As)不引导主语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: what引导主语从句且作从句宾语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他所说的是真的。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: This is ___ I want to tell you.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：这就是我想告诉你的。
questions.explanation: what引导表语从句，作从句中tell的宾语（tell sb sth中的sth），意思是'...的事情'。'what I want to tell you'表示'我想告诉你的事情'。what在从句中必须充当成分（此处为宾语），而that不充当成分。选项A(that)不充当成分，从句结构不完整；选项C(which)表示'哪个'不合语境；选项D(all what)错误，正确说法是all that或what。
questions.knowledgePoint: what引导表语从句且作从句宾语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这就是我想告诉你的。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I don't know ___ happened to him. (填入正确的引导词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：我不知道他发生了什么事。
questions.explanation: what引导宾语从句，作从句的主语（happened的主语），意思是'...的事情'。'what happened to him'表示'他发生了什么事'。what在从句中充当主语成分，而that不作成分。如果用that，则happened没有主语，结构不完整。what = the thing that，既当连接词又当成分。
questions.knowledgePoint: what引导宾语从句且作从句主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我不知道他发生了什么事。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The teacher made him ___ the classroom.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：老师让他打扫教室。
questions.explanation: 使役动词make后跟宾语补足语时省略to，用动词原形：make sb do sth。'made him clean the classroom'中clean是原形，to被省略。使役动词make/let/have后面都跟sb do sth（省略to）。注意：变为被动语态后，省略的to要补回来：He was made to clean the classroom。选项A(to clean)不能用在make后；选项C(cleaning)是-ing形式错误；选项D(cleaned)过去分词错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: 使役动词make/let/have后跟sb do sth（省略to）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 老师让他打扫教室。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I saw him ___ the street.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：我看见他穿过了街道。
questions.explanation: 感官动词see后跟宾语补足语时可以省略to，用动词原形：see sb do sth（看见某人做了某事，强调全过程）。'saw him cross the street'表示看见他穿过了街道。感官动词see/hear/watch/notice/feel后跟sb do sth（省略to，表全过程）或sb doing sth（保留-ing，表正在进行）。注意：变为被动语态后to要补回：He was seen to cross the street。
questions.knowledgePoint: 感官动词see/hear/watch后跟sb do sth（省略to）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我看见他穿过了街道。

questions.question: True or False: 'He was made to clean the room.' is correct because when 'make' is used in the passive voice, 'to' must be restored.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'He was made to clean the room.'是正确的，因为make用于被动语态时to必须补回。
questions.explanation: 正确。使役动词make在主动语态中省略to（make sb do sth），但在被动语态中to必须补回来（sb be made to do sth）。'He was made to clean the room.'是正确的被动形式。同理，感官动词see/hear/watch等在被动语态中也要补回to：He was seen to cross the street。这是不定式to省略的重要规则：主动省略，被动补回。
questions.knowledgePoint: make/see等变被动语态后to要补回
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他被要求打扫房间。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ being late made the teacher angry.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他迟到让老师生气了。
questions.explanation: 动名词的复合结构由'逻辑主语 + 动名词'构成。在正式语体中，逻辑主语用物主代词或名词所有格：His being late（他的迟到）。'His being late made the teacher angry'中His是being late的逻辑主语。正式语体用所有格（his/John's），口语中也可用宾格（him/John）。选项A(He)主格不能作动名词逻辑主语；选项B(Him)是宾格，口语可用但不够正式；选项D(He's)是he is的缩写，不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: 动名词复合结构：逻辑主语用所有格（正式）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他迟到让老师生气了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Do you mind ___ opening the window?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：你介意我开窗户吗？
questions.explanation: 动名词复合结构中逻辑主语用所有格：my opening the window。'Do you mind my opening the window?'表示你介意我开窗吗。mind后接动名词，动名词前加逻辑主语。正式语体用所有格my，口语中也用宾格me（Do you mind me opening...）。两者都可接受，但所有格更正式。选项C(I)主格错误；选项D(mine)名词性物主代词不修饰动名词。
questions.knowledgePoint: mind后动名词复合结构：my/me + doing
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你介意我开窗户吗？

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (Tom) coming to the party surprised everyone. (用所有格形式)
questions.questionCn: 填空：Tom来参加聚会让所有人惊讶。
questions.explanation: 动名词复合结构中，名词作逻辑主语时用名词所有格：Tom's coming。'Tom's coming to the party surprised everyone'中Tom's是coming的逻辑主语。名词所有格在句首作逻辑主语时通常用所有格形式（Tom's）。如果不在句首，口语中也可用普通格（Tom coming），但在句首正式语体中用所有格更佳。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词所有格+动名词构成复合结构
questions.sentenceTranslation: Tom来参加聚会让所有人惊讶。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The book ___ by him is very popular.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他写的书非常受欢迎。
questions.explanation: 过去分词written作后置定语修饰book，表示被动和完成。'the book written by him'等于'the book that was written by him'。及物动词的过去分词作定语表示被动（被写的书）。过去分词作后置定语相当于一个被动语态的定语从句的简写。选项A(writing)现在分词表示主动，书不会主动写；选项C(write)原形不能作定语；选项D(to write)不定式表将来，不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: 过去分词作后置定语表被动（=定语从句简写）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他写的书非常受欢迎。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The boy ___ in the accident was sent to hospital.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：在事故中受伤的男孩被送往医院。
questions.explanation: 过去分词injured作后置定语修饰boy，表示被动（被受伤的男孩）。'the boy injured in the accident'等于'the boy who was injured in the accident'。及物动词的过去分词作定语表被动。injure是及物动词，其过去分词injured表示'被受伤的'。选项A(injuring)现在分词表主动，男孩不会主动受伤；选项C(injure)原形不能作定语；选项D(to injure)不定式表将来。
questions.knowledgePoint: 过去分词作后置定语表被动（injured=被受伤的）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 在事故中受伤的男孩被送往医院。

questions.question: True or False: 'The fallen leaves' and 'The leaves that have fallen' have the same meaning.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'The fallen leaves'和'The leaves that have fallen'意思相同。
questions.explanation: 正确。不及物动词的过去分词作定语表示完成而非被动。fallen是fall的过去分词，'the fallen leaves'（落叶）等于'the leaves that have fallen'（已经落下的叶子）。不及物动词的过去分词只表完成（已落下），不表被动，因为fall是不及物动词没有被动语态。常见的不及物动词过去分词作定语：fallen leaves（落叶）, retired worker（退休工人）, returned student（归国学生）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不及物动词过去分词作定语表完成（非被动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 落叶。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ I known the truth, I would have told you.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：如果我早知道真相，我就告诉你了。
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件句中，如果从句含有had，可以省略if并将had提到主语前面形成倒装。'Had I known the truth'等于'If I had known the truth'。这是与过去事实相反的虚拟语气。if省略倒装的条件：从句中有were/had/should时，省略if，将were/had/should提到主语前。选项A(If)如果用则需要完整句子If I had known；选项C(Have)不能用于倒装；选项D(Should)用于与将来事实相反的虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: if省略倒装：Had + 主语 + 过去分词（与过去相反）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我早知道真相，我就告诉你了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ it rain tomorrow, we would stay at home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：万一明天下雨，我们就待在家里。
questions.explanation: 与将来事实相反的虚拟条件句中，从句可用should + 动词原形，此时可省略if将should提到主语前倒装。'Should it rain tomorrow'等于'If it should rain tomorrow'。表示对将来的不太可能发生的情况的假设。if省略倒装的三种情况：1.Had + 主语 + 过去分词（与过去相反）；2.Were + 主语 + ...（与现在相反）；3.Should + 主语 + 动词原形（与将来相反）。选项B(Had)用于过去；选项D(Were)用于现在。
questions.knowledgePoint: if省略倒装：Should + 主语 + do（与将来相反）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 万一明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ I you, I would not do that. (省略if的倒装形式，与现在事实相反)
questions.questionCn: 填空：如果我是你，我就不会那样做。
questions.explanation: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句中，从句用were（所有人称），可省略if将were提到主语前倒装。'Were I you'等于'If I were you'。在虚拟语气中，be动词一律用were。if省略倒装：Were + 主语 + ...（与现在相反）。注意虚拟语气中I/he/she/it都用were而非was。
questions.knowledgePoint: if省略倒装：Were + 主语（与现在相反）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我是你，我就不会那样做。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Without your help, I ___ the exam.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：没有你的帮助，我就通不过考试了。
questions.explanation: without引导含蓄虚拟语气，表示'如果没有...'。本句是对过去事实的假设（考试已经结束），主句用would have + 过去分词。'would have failed'表示就会失败。without引导的虚拟语气：与现在/将来相反用would do；与过去相反用would have done。本句语境是过去（已经考完），所以用would have failed。选项A(would fail)用于现在/将来；选项C(will fail)不是虚拟语气；选项D(failed)一般过去时错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: without引导含蓄虚拟：与过去相反用would have done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 没有你的帮助，我就通不过考试了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: But for the rain, we ___ a good harvest.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：要不是那场雨，我们就不会有好收成。
questions.explanation: but for表示'要不是'，引导含蓄虚拟语气。本句是对过去事实的假设（收成已定），主句用would have + 过去分词。'would have had'表示就会有/就会经历。but for = without = if it were not for（现在）/ if it had not been for（过去）。本句指过去的收成，用would have had。选项A(would have)用于现在/将来；选项C(will have)非虚拟；选项D(had)时态错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: but for引导含蓄虚拟：与过去相反用would have done
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是那场雨，我们就不会有好收成。

questions.question: True or False: 'Without water, there would be no life on earth.' correctly uses the subjunctive mood for a present/future hypothetical situation.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'Without water, there would be no life on earth.'正确使用了虚拟语气表示与现在/将来相反的假设。
questions.explanation: 正确。without引导含蓄虚拟语气，本句表示与现在/将来事实相反的假设（没有水就没有生命），主句用would do（would be）。'there would be no life'使用would be表示与现在相反的虚拟结果。without引导虚拟语气的规则：与现在/将来相反用would do；与过去相反用would have done。本句是普遍真理性的现在假设，用would be正确。
questions.knowledgePoint: without含蓄虚拟：与现在/将来相反用would do
questions.sentenceTranslation: 没有水，地球上就没有生命。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Not only ___ English, but he also speaks French.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。
questions.explanation: not only放在句首时，其后的句子要部分倒装（将助动词/do/does/did/be/情态动词提到主语前）。'does he speak'是倒装形式。但but also后面的句子不倒装（he also speaks正常语序）。倒装规则：Not only + 助动词/be/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词。选项A(he speaks)没有倒装；选项C(he speak)既没倒装动词形式也错；选项D(speaks he)倒装方式错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: not only在句首时部分倒装，but also后不倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅会说英语，还会说法语。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Not only ___ the book, but he also wrote a review.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他不仅读了这本书，还写了一篇书评。
questions.explanation: not only在句首，后面的句子要部分倒装。本句是过去时（read的过去式read），所以用did提前倒装：did he read。not only倒装规则：根据时态选择助动词——一般现在时用do/does，一般过去时用did，be/情态动词直接提前。'Not only did he read...but he also wrote...'前半句倒装（did he read），后半句不倒装（he also wrote）。选项A(he read)没倒装；选项C(he reads)时态错误且没倒装；选项D(does he read)时态错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: not only句首倒装：过去时用did + 主语 + 动词原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅读了这本书，还写了一篇书评。

questions.question: True or False: In 'Not only is she beautiful, but she is also intelligent.', both clauses are inverted.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：在'Not only is she beautiful, but she is also intelligent.'中，两个从句都倒装了。
questions.explanation: 错误。not only...but also结构中，只有not only后面的句子倒装，but (also)后面的句子不倒装。'Not only is she beautiful'（倒装，is提前）正确，但'but she is also intelligent'没有倒装（正常语序she is）。所以不是两个从句都倒装，只有前半句倒装。这是not only倒装的关键规则：前倒后不倒。
questions.knowledgePoint: not only倒装规则：前倒后不倒
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她不仅美丽，而且聪明。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: I ___ leave until the rain stopped.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：直到雨停了我才离开。
questions.explanation: not...until表示'直到...才'。'I didn't leave until the rain stopped'表示直到雨停才离开。not...until结构：主句（否定）+ until + 时间状语从句。主句用否定didn't leave，until从句用过去时stopped。含义是雨停之前没走，雨停了才走。选项B(did)是肯定，意思变为'直到雨停一直离开'不通；选项C(don't)时态与stopped不匹配；选项D(won't)时态不匹配。
questions.knowledgePoint: not...until：直到...才（主句否定+until从句）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到雨停了我才离开。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Not until he came back ___ the news.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：直到他回来我才知道这个消息。
questions.explanation: not until放在句首时，主句要部分倒装。'Not until he came back did I know the news'中did I know是倒装形式。not until句型倒装：Not until + 时间状语从句 + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词原形。正常语序是I didn't know the news until he came back，倒装后not until提前，主句部分倒装。选项A(I knew)没倒装；选项C(I did know)语序错误；选项D(knew I)倒装方式错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: not until句首时主句部分倒装
questions.sentenceTranslation: 直到他回来我才知道这个消息。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He didn't go to bed ___ he finished his homework. (直到...才)
questions.questionCn: 填空：他直到完成作业才上床睡觉。
questions.explanation: not...until表示'直到...才'。'He didn't go to bed until he finished his homework'表示直到完成作业才睡觉。not...until结构：主句否定（didn't go）+ until + 从句。含义是完成作业之前没睡，完成了才睡。注意：肯定句用until表示'做到...为止'（He worked until midnight），否定句用not...until表示'直到...才'。
questions.knowledgePoint: not...until：直到...才（否定主句+until）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他直到完成作业才上床睡觉。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He is ___ tired to walk on.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他太累了走不动了。
questions.explanation: too...to表示'太...以至于不能'，自带否定含义。'too tired to walk on'表示太累了不能继续走。too...to结构：too + 形容词/副词 + to + 动词原形，意思是'太...以至于不能...'。注意too...to本身就含否定，不需要再加not。选项B(so)需要搭配that从句（so...that...）；选项C(very)不能搭配to do；选项D(such)修饰名词不修饰形容词。
questions.knowledgePoint: too...to：太...以至于不能（自带否定）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他太累了走不动了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: He is old ___ to go to school.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他够大了可以上学了。
questions.explanation: enough to表示'足够...可以...'，是肯定的。'old enough to go to school'表示年龄足够大可以上学。enough to结构：形容词/副词 + enough + to + 动词原形。注意enough要放在形容词/副词后面（old enough），而不是前面。选项A(too)表示太...不能，意思相反；选项C(so)需搭配that从句；选项D(very)不能搭配to do。too...to（否定）与enough to（肯定）是反义句型。
questions.knowledgePoint: enough to：足够...可以（enough放形容词后）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他够大了可以上学了。

questions.question: True or False: 'The box is too heavy for me to carry.' means 'I can carry the box.'
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'The box is too heavy for me to carry.'的意思是'我能搬动这个箱子。'
questions.explanation: 错误。'too heavy for me to carry'表示'太重以至于我搬不动'，意思是不能搬动。too...to自带否定含义，表示'太...以至于不能...'。所以这句话的意思是'我搬不动这个箱子'，而不是'我能搬动'。too...to可以转换为so...that...not结构：The box is so heavy that I cannot carry it。
questions.knowledgePoint: too...to自带否定含义：太...以至于不能
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这个箱子太重了我搬不动。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ you read, ___ you will know.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：你读得越多，知道得就越多。
questions.explanation: the more...the more...表示'越...越...'。'The more you read, the more you will know'表示读得越多知道得越多。结构：The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...。前半句是条件（从句），后半句是结果（主句），两个the都是副词。注意前后都要用the + 比较级。选项B/C/D都缺少了其中一个the，不完整。
questions.knowledgePoint: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...：越...越...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你读得越多，知道得就越多。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ you work, ___ your grades will be.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：你越努力，成绩就会越好。
questions.explanation: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...句型中，前后都要用比较级。'The harder you work, the better your grades will be'中harder是hard的比较级，better是good的比较级。注意形容词要用比较级形式：hard→harder, good→better。选项A(The hard; the good)用了原级不是比较级；选项C和D各有一个没用比较级。
questions.knowledgePoint: the + 比较级, the + 比较级（前后都用比较级）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你越努力，成绩就会越好。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The ___ (much) you practice, the ___ (well) you will speak English. (用比较级)
questions.questionCn: 填空：你练习得越多，英语就说得越好。
questions.explanation: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...句型。much的比较级是more，well的比较级是better。'The more you practice, the better you will speak English'表示练习越多说得越好。注意much/many的比较级是more，good/well的比较级是better。两个the都是副词，分别修饰比较级。
questions.knowledgePoint: the more..., the better...：越多...越好...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你练习得越多，英语就说得越好。

gm_115.grammarName: 不定代词的修饰语位置

questions.category: 不定代词的修饰语位置
questions.question: Choose the correct word order: I have ___ to tell you.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的语序：我有重要的事情要告诉你。
questions.explanation: 修饰不定代词（something/anything/nothing/everything等）的形容词要放在不定代词后面，即后置修饰。'something important'表示重要的事情。规则：形容词修饰不定代词时必须后置（不定代词 + 形容词），如something new, nothing serious, anything wrong。选项A(important something)形容词位置错误；选项C(important anything)位置和词都错（肯定句用something）；选项D(anything important)虽然位置对但肯定句应用something。
questions.knowledgePoint: 修饰不定代词的形容词必须后置
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我有重要的事情要告诉你。

questions.category: 不定代词的修饰语位置
questions.question: Choose the correct word order: Is there ___ wrong with your phone?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的语序：你的手机有什么问题吗？
questions.explanation: 修饰不定代词的形容词后置：anything wrong。疑问句和否定句用anything（不用something），形容词wrong放在anything后面。'anything wrong with your phone'表示你的手机有什么毛病。规则：疑问句/否定句用anything，形容词后置。选项A(wrong anything)形容词位置错误；选项C/D用了something，但疑问句应用anything。
questions.knowledgePoint: 疑问句用anything，形容词后置
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你的手机有什么问题吗？

questions.category: 不定代词的修饰语位置
questions.question: True or False: 'I have nothing else to say.' is grammatically correct because 'else' comes after the indefinite pronoun.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'I have nothing else to say.'语法正确，因为else放在不定代词后面。
questions.explanation: 正确。else修饰不定代词（something/anything/nothing等）时也要放在不定代词后面。'nothing else'表示没有别的东西了。与形容词一样，else也后置修饰不定代词：something else（别的什么）, anything else（其他什么）, nothing else（没有别的）, nobody else（没有别人）。'I have nothing else to say.'表示我没有别的话要说了，语法正确。
questions.knowledgePoint: else也放在不定代词后面（后置修饰）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我没有别的话要说了。

questions.question: Choose the correct position: He ___ goes to school by bus.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的位置：他总是坐公交车上学。
questions.explanation: 频度副词（always/usually/often/sometimes/never等）放在实义动词前、be动词/助动词/情态动词后。'He always goes'中always放在实义动词goes前面。频度副词位置规则：1.实义动词前（He always goes）；2.be动词后（He is always late）；3.助动词后（He has always been...）。选项B(goes always)频度副词不能放动词后；选项C(always go)动词形式错误（第三人称单数）；选项D(always to)结构错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: 频度副词放在实义动词前、be动词后
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他总是坐公交车上学。

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: ___
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的句子：他英语说得很流利。
questions.explanation: 方式副词（well/quickly/carefully等）放在动词或宾语后面。'He speaks English well'中well放在动词和宾语之后。方式副词位置规则：1.动词后（无宾语时）；2.宾语后（有宾语时），不能放在动词和宾语之间。'speak English well'正确，'speak well English'错误。选项B(well speaks)方式副词不能放在动词前；选项C(speaks well English)副词不能放在动词和宾语之间；选项D语序完全错误。
questions.knowledgePoint: 方式副词放在动词或宾语后面
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他英语说得很流利。

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct word order: She is ___ (very/beautiful). (用very修饰beautiful)
questions.questionCn: 填空：她非常漂亮。
questions.explanation: 程度副词（very/quite/so/too等）放在形容词或副词前面修饰。'very beautiful'中very放在形容词beautiful前面。程度副词位置规则：程度副词 + 形容词/副词。'She is very beautiful'表示她非常漂亮。注意程度副词always在形容词前，不能放在后面（beautiful very是错误的）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 程度副词放在形容词/副词前面
questions.sentenceTranslation: 她非常漂亮。

gm_117.grammarName: 数词的表达（分数/小数/倍数）

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ of the students are girls.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：三分之二的学生是女生。
questions.explanation: 英语分数表达法：分子用基数词，分母用序数词。当分子大于1时，分母序数词要加s。2/3 = two thirds（分子two用基数词，分母third用序数词，分子大于1所以加s变thirds）。1/3 = one third（分子为1不加s）。1/2 = one half或a half。1/4 = one fourth或a quarter。选项A(Two third)分子大于1分母没加s；选项C(Second three)分子分母用反；选项D(Two three)没用序数词。
questions.knowledgePoint: 分数：分子基数词+分母序数词，分子>1分母加s
questions.sentenceTranslation: 三分之二的学生是女生。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: This room is ___ that one.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：这个房间是那个房间的三倍大。
choices: A. three times as big as
C. three time as big as
questions.explanation: 倍数表达法之一：A is + 倍数 + as + 形容词原级 + as + B。'three times as big as that one'表示是那个的三倍大。倍数用times（三倍=three times）。'A是B的n倍大'有三种表达法：1.n times as big as B；2.n times bigger than B（n times the size of B）；3.n times the size of B。选项B(bigger as)搭配错误（应用than）；选项C(time)少了s；选项D(big as)缺少as big as结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倍数表达：A is n times as adj. as B
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这个房间是那个房间的三倍大。

questions.question: True or False: '0.5' is read as 'zero point five' in English.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'0.5'在英语中读作'zero point five'。
questions.explanation: 正确。小数的读法：小数点读作point，数字逐个读。0.5 = zero point five（也可以读作nought point five）。3.14 = three point one four（小数点后的数字逐个读，不读作fourteen）。0.25 = zero point two five。小数点前的0可以读zero或nought（英式）或省略。所以'zero point five'是0.5的正确读法。
questions.knowledgePoint: 小数读法：小数点point，数字逐个读
questions.sentenceTranslation: 0.5读作zero point five。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The old man lives ___, but he doesn't feel ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：这位老人独自居住，但他不觉得孤独。
questions.explanation: alone表示'独自一人'（客观状态，没有同伴），lonely表示'孤独的/寂寞的'（主观感受）。'lives alone'表示独自居住（客观状态），'doesn't feel lonely'表示不觉得孤独（主观感受）。alone是客观事实（只有一个人），lonely是心理感受（可能身边有人但感到孤独）。alone通常作表语或后置状语，lonely可作表语和定语（a lonely house）。两者意思不同不能混用。
questions.knowledgePoint: alone（独自，客观）与lonely（孤独，主观）区别
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这位老人独自居住，但他不觉得孤独。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The book is very ___. I'm ___ in it.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的词：这本书很有趣，我对它很感兴趣。
questions.explanation: interesting表示'令人感兴趣的'（修饰物，主动意义），interested表示'感兴趣的'（修饰人，被动意义）。'The book is interesting'书令人感兴趣（书是引起兴趣的主体），'I'm interested in it'我对它感兴趣（人是感受者）。-ing形容词表示'令人...的'修饰物（exciting令人兴奋的）；-ed形容词表示'感到...的'修饰人（excited感到兴奋的）。常见类似组合：boring/bored, surprising/surprised, tiring/tired。
questions.knowledgePoint: -ing形容词修饰物（令人...），-ed形容词修饰人（感到...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 这本书很有趣，我对它很感兴趣。

questions.question: True or False: 'He is tired because the work is tiring.' uses 'tired' and 'tiring' correctly.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'He is tired because the work is tiring.'中tired和tiring使用正确。
questions.explanation: 正确。tired表示'感到疲倦的'（修饰人，被动意义），tiring表示'令人疲倦的'（修饰物，主动意义）。'He is tired'他感到疲倦（人是感受者），'the work is tiring'工作令人疲倦（工作是引起疲倦的主体）。这与interesting/interested是同样的规律：-ing形容词表示'令人...的'修饰物；-ed形容词表示'感到...的'修饰人。两者使用正确。
questions.knowledgePoint: tiring（令人疲倦的，修饰物）与tired（感到疲倦的，修饰人）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他感到疲倦因为工作令人疲倦。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: His grandmother ___ him after his parents died.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：他父母去世后，奶奶把他抚养长大。
questions.explanation: bring up表示'抚养/养育'。'brought him up'表示把他抚养长大。bring的常见短语：bring up（抚养/提出）, bring about（引起/导致）, bring in（引进/赚得）, bring out（出版/使显现）, bring back（带回/使回忆起）, bring down（降低/打倒）。选项B(brought about)表示引起；选项C(brought in)表示引进；选项D(brought out)表示出版/使显现，都不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: bring up：抚养/养育
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他父母去世后，奶奶把他抚养长大。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: The meeting was ___ because of the storm.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：因为暴风雨，会议被取消了。
questions.explanation: call off表示'取消'。'The meeting was called off'表示会议被取消。call的常见短语：call off（取消）, call on（拜访/号召）, call up（打电话/回忆起）, call for（需要/要求）, call in（召来/请来）, call out（大声喊叫）。选项A(called on)表示拜访/号召；选项B(called up)表示打电话；选项D(called for)表示需要，都不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: call off：取消
questions.sentenceTranslation: 因为暴风雨，会议被取消了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: We must carry ___ the plan immediately. (执行计划，填入适当介/副词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：我们必须立即执行这个计划。
questions.explanation: carry out表示'执行/实施'。'carry out the plan'表示执行计划。carry的常见短语：carry out（执行/实施）, carry on（继续/进行）, carry away（搬走/使激动得失去理智）, carry through（完成/坚持）。'carry on'表示继续（carry on working继续工作），'carry out'表示执行（carry out a plan执行计划），两者意思不同需区分。
questions.knowledgePoint: carry out：执行/实施
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们必须立即执行这个计划。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: I ___ an old friend in the supermarket yesterday.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：昨天我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。
questions.explanation: come across表示'偶遇/偶然发现'。'came across an old friend'表示偶遇老朋友。come的常见短语：come across（偶遇/发现）, come up with（想出/提出）, come true（实现/成真）, come to（苏醒/共计）, come about（发生）, come out（出版/结果是）, come along（一起来/出现）。选项B(came up with)表示想出；选项C(came true)表示实现，但主语通常是梦想；选项D(came to)表示苏醒/共计，都不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: come across：偶遇/偶然发现
questions.sentenceTranslation: 昨天我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase: Please ___ the light. It's too dark here.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的短语：请打开灯，这里太暗了。
questions.explanation: turn on表示'打开（电器/水龙头等）'。'turn on the light'表示开灯。turn的常见短语：turn on（打开）, turn off（关掉）, turn up（出现/调大）, turn down（拒绝/调小）, turn out（结果是/生产）, turn over（翻转/移交）, turn into（变成）。选项B(turn off)表示关掉，与语境相反；选项C(turn up)表示出现/调大；选项D(turn down)表示拒绝/调小，都不合语境。
questions.knowledgePoint: turn on：打开（电器等）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 请打开灯，这里太暗了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Let's go ___ the lesson before the exam. (复习功课，填入适当介/副词)
questions.questionCn: 填空：考试前我们复习一下功课吧。
questions.explanation: go over表示'复习/仔细检查'。'go over the lesson'表示复习功课。go的常见短语：go over（复习/检查）, go on（继续/发生）, go through（经历/仔细检查）, go out（出去/熄灭）, go ahead（前进/进行）, go by（经过/流逝）, go up（上升/增长）, go down（下降）。'go over'强调复习检查已有内容，'go through'强调经历或仔细审查过程。
questions.knowledgePoint: go over：复习/检查
questions.sentenceTranslation: 考试前我们复习一下功课吧。

gm_121.grammarName: 固定句式（It takes sb...to do等）

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ me two hours to finish the homework.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：我花了两个小时完成作业。
questions.explanation: It takes sb time to do sth表示'花某人多少时间做某事'。'It takes me two hours to finish the homework'表示花我两小时完成作业。花费的四种表达：1.It takes sb time to do sth（花时间）；2.sb spends time/money doing/on sth（人作主语）；3.sth costs sb money（物作主语花金钱）；4.sb pays money for sth（人付钱）。选项B(costs)用于花钱不用于时间；选项C(spends)主语应是人不是it；选项D(pays)主语应是人且搭配for。
questions.knowledgePoint: It takes sb time to do sth：花某人时间做某事
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我花了两个小时完成作业。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The reason ___ he was late was ___ he missed the bus.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确的形式：他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。
questions.explanation: The reason why...is that...是固定句式，表示'...的原因是...'。why引导定语从句修饰reason，that引导表语从句说明原因。'The reason why he was late was that he missed the bus'表示他迟到的原因是错过了公交车。注意：reason后面的表语从句用that引导，不用because（避免语意重复：reason和because都表示原因）。选项B/D中第一个that不合适，修饰reason表原因用why；选项C用了because造成语意重复。
questions.knowledgePoint: The reason why...is that...：...的原因是...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is no use ___ (cry) over spilt milk. (覆水难收，用适当形式)
questions.questionCn: 填空：覆水难收，后悔无用。
questions.explanation: It is no use doing sth是固定句式，表示'做某事是没用的'，后接动名词（doing）。'It is no use crying over spilt milk'是英语谚语'覆水难收/后悔无用'。类似句式还有：It is no good doing sth（做某事没好处）, There is no point in doing sth（做某事没意义）。这些句式都要求接动名词形式，不能用不定式。注意spilt milk（洒了的牛奶）比喻已经发生无法挽回的事。
questions.knowledgePoint: It is no use doing sth：做某事没用（接动名词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 覆水难收，后悔无用。

gm_122.grammarName: 定语从句的嵌套结构（多层定语从句）

questions.question: The book ___ you bought ___ was written by a famous author is very inspiring.
questions.questionCn: 你买的那本由一位著名作家写的书非常鼓舞人心。
questions.explanation: 这是一个双层定语从句。第一层：that you bought修饰the book，that在从句中作bought的宾语；第二层：which was written by a famous author也修饰the book，which在从句中作主语。注意：两个定语从句并列修饰同一个先行词，不是嵌套关系，但形式上连续出现两个关系代词容易混淆。选项A的第二个空不填会导致句子缺主语；选项D的what不能引导定语从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 多层定语从句的识别：两个定语从句修饰同一先行词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你买的那本由一位著名作家写的书非常鼓舞人心。

questions.question: There is a technique ___ has been developed in recent years ___ makes rapid progress possible.
questions.questionCn: 近年来发展起来的一项技术使得快速进步成为可能。
questions.explanation: 这是分隔式定语从句与嵌套的结合。先行词是a technique，第一层定语从句that has been developed in recent years修饰technique（that作主语），第二层定语从句which makes rapid progress possible也修饰technique（which作主语）。两个从句被时间状语in recent years隔开。第一个that不能省略（作主语），第二个which也不能省略（作主语）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 分隔式多层定语从句：先行词与第二层从句被其他成分隔开
questions.sentenceTranslation: 近年来发展起来的一项技术使得快速进步成为可能。

questions.question: 判断句子正误：The scientist who we met yesterday had discovered a new element that could revolutionize the whole industry.
questions.questionCn: 判断句子正误：我们昨天遇到的那位科学家发现了一种可能彻底改变整个行业的新元素。
questions.explanation: 句子完全正确。这是一个包含两个定语从句的复合句：第一个定语从句who we met yesterday修饰the scientist（who作met的宾语，也可用whom或省略）；第二个定语从句that could revolutionize the whole industry修饰a new element（that作主语）。主句是The scientist had discovered a new element。两个定语从句分别修饰不同的先行词，不存在嵌套关系。
questions.knowledgePoint: 并列定语从句：两个定语从句分别修饰不同的先行词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们昨天遇到的那位科学家发现了一种可能彻底改变整个行业的新元素。

gm_123.grammarName: 介词+关系代词的高级用法

questions.category: 介词+关系代词的高级用法
questions.question: The speed ___ light travels is about 300,000 kilometers per second.
questions.questionCn: 光传播的速度约为每秒30万公里。
questions.explanation: "以...速度"的固定搭配是at the speed of，因此介词用at。at which = at the speed，which指代the speed。介词的选择取决于先行词的习惯搭配：speed与at搭配。选项A(in which)常用于表示地点或方式；选项C(by which)常用于表示方式或手段；选项D(with which)常用于表示工具。
questions.knowledgePoint: 介词+which的介词选择：根据先行词的固定搭配
questions.sentenceTranslation: 光传播的速度约为每秒30万公里。

questions.category: 介词+关系代词的高级用法
questions.question: There are more than 50 students in our class, most ___ are from the south.
questions.questionCn: 我们班有50多个学生，其中大部分来自南方。
questions.explanation: 表示整体中的部分时，用"部分词+of+关系代词"结构。先行词是students（指人），所以用whom不用which。most of whom = most of the students。常见的部分词有：some, most, many, much, all, both, none, half, one, two等。选项B的which指物，不能指人；选项C的介词in搭配错误；选项D的among和which都不对。
questions.knowledgePoint: 部分与整体结构：most/some/all + of + whom/which
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们班有50多个学生，其中大部分来自南方。

questions.category: 介词+关系代词的高级用法
questions.question: 判断句子正误：The house in that I used to live has been pulled down.
questions.questionCn: 判断句子正误：我过去住的那所房子已经被拆除了。
